The full presentation
The crew and who does what, how a change gets from an idea to the game, the rules we work by, what the game runs on,
what the playtests taught us, the pace and cost so far, how the idea board works, and where we go from here, together.
Open the presentation Bundled numbers as of <date>
Pull requests, commits, tests, decisions, AI spend, Jev latency and persona scores come live (from GitHub and from the app) when a source is up.
Each group says “live” or “as of” its date. The other numbers come from
docs/team-page/data.json
in tales-forge-docs. Where we have no number, it says “not measured yet”.
